# 0x258 — `imu_derived`

DLC 8 · 100 Hz · status: **hypothesis**

A second IMU frame with packed fields. One word behaves like a pitch rate with the cornering component removed, which suggests the IMU computes its own attitude; the rest is not decoded.

## Layout

Bytes are numbered from 0. Multi-byte values are big-endian unless a row says otherwise. Bit 7 is the most significant bit of a byte.

| Byte | Content |
|---|---|
| B0 | `b0b3_unknown` |
| B1 | `b0b3_unknown` |
| B2 | `b0b3_unknown` |
| B3 | `b0b3_unknown` |
| B4 | `b4b5_always_zero` |
| B5 | `b4b5_always_zero` |
| B6 | `pitch_rate_level` |
| B7 | `pitch_rate_level` |

## Signals

| Signal | Where | Type | Value | Unit | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `b0b3_unknown` | B0:B3 | uint32 BE | raw |  | unknown |
| `b4b5_always_zero` | B4:B5 | uint16 BE | raw |  | unknown |
| `pitch_rate_level` | B6:B7 | uint16 BE | raw × 0.01 − 300 | deg/s | hypothesis (medium) |

### `b0b3_unknown`

Packed fields. The low nibble of B0 takes only the values 1 and 2 and leans toward 1 in left-hand corners; the low nibble of B2 steps with lean angle modulo 16. No plain 8- or 16-bit lean value was found in a bit-level search.

### `b4b5_always_zero`

Always 0x0000 (311 000 frames of three full-rate captures).

### `pitch_rate_level`

Zero at 30000-30004. Follows the 0x254 pitch rate with the −yaw × tan(lean) corner term removed, one frame later (correlation 0.94-0.98 on three rides against 0.52 for the raw pitch rate). Reads as the pitch rate in the road frame.
